bank.q: Explain the steps to run a SELECT with JDBC.
bank.model: Open a Connection, create a PreparedStatement, set parameters, executeQuery, loop with rs.next() reading columns, close resources (try-with-resources).

bank.q: Why use PreparedStatement instead of Statement?
bank.model: It uses ? placeholders so user input is data not SQL (prevents injection) and it can be precompiled and reused faster.

bank.title: Mini project: Student DAO
bank.brief: Write StudentDAO with findById(int) returning the name or null, listAll() returning an ArrayList<String>, and updateGpa(int,double) returning boolean.
